About Overdott

Technology should make work clearer, safer and more connected.

Overdott Technologies Limited helps organizations explore, implement and manage practical technology solutions.

Our purpose

Practical technology, considered as a whole.

Organizations rely on connected infrastructure, secure access, useful software and digital channels. Overdott brings these needs into one conversation, from technology sourcing and integration to digital development and support.

Our approach is to understand the requirement first, explain options clearly and agree on work that fits the engagement.

Our mission

Help businesses use technology effectively.

To help businesses adopt, integrate and use technology effectively through practical solutions, dependable technical services and a commitment to security, usability and long-term value.

Our vision

Build trust through useful technology.

To become a trusted technology solutions and integration partner for businesses in Kenya and, over time, across Africa.

Our values

How we approach the work.

These principles guide how we scope recommendations, communicate and consider what happens after implementation.

Practical innovation

Choose technology for the problems it can solve, not novelty alone.

Security and responsibility

Consider security, access and risk as part of implementation.

Integrity and transparency

Be clear about scope, assumptions, responsibilities and limitations.

Customer-focused delivery

Keep requirements and the people using the systems in view.

Continuous learning

Stay curious as tools, risks and business needs evolve.

Long-term value

Consider maintainability and ownership alongside the initial decision.

Start with the outcome you need.

Tell us what you are trying to solve, and we'll explore practical next steps.
